scope: Four reboot-separated first-window cases, order process/original/original/process. Each boot runs exactly one saved-input GUI window after a fixed two-minute post-login settle.
prerequisites: User authorizes Windows restarts and confirms automatic/login availability
record boot identifier, uptime, session, AC, process/thread policy and no prior target in that boot
same frozen input/model/real SDK and existing semantic gates
acceptance: both original-first windows severe: queue lower >=1000 and scheduled contact-to-paint >=1000ms
both process-first windows queue upper <=250 and scheduled contact-to-paint <=250ms
input lateness <=100ms, full report/quality/raw exact, all process cleanup confirmed

decisions.support_candidate: original severe twice and process bounded twice
decisions.reject_candidate: process severe in either qualified cold window
decisions.inconclusive: cold original severity not reproduced or any boot/context/input gate fails

constraints: No human,USB,Run or formal program change
No extra boots/windows after frozen four
No CPU/GIL percentage even if candidate succeeds
